name: Llimiana (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged towards the hoist with a yellow castle with black door and windows.
history: The official flag of Llimiana is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the yellow castle with black door and windows of the arms, 4/9 of the height and 7/27 of the length of the cloth, set at 1/9 from the upper edge; approved on 20 March 2006 and published in the DOGC on 3 April 2006.

features.role: door and windows of the castle
